task_definition.task_description: Please check for any discovered lock tickets in the living room, then get the mesh snapshot for the living room light and publish it to the app for user_123 with high priority. After that, analyze the text "Light light_living: off, 0% (white)", set that light to red at 100% brightness, restart the main lock device, and finally snapshot the IoT logs workspace and send me a high-priority alert.

user_input.query: Could you please check for any discovered lock tickets in the living_room? After that, get the mesh snapshot for the living room light and publish it to the app for user_123 with high priority. Next, I need you to analyze the text "Light light_living: off, 0% (white)" and set the light_living device to red at 100% brightness. Once that's done, restart the main lock device. Finally, take a snapshot of the IoT logs workspace located at /home/user/iot_logs and send me a high-priority alert.
